signature.caption: reviving a 1990s game
signature.why: Our pick: he pointed Claude at BattleTris, a game he started in the mid-1990s that had not built in over 20 years. Claude found the 64-bit stack smash that kept it from running. It is his case for agents doing tedious, open-ended restoration nobody would finish by hand.
signature.quote: It is no exaggeration to say that this was brought to us by Claude.

archetype.why: Steers Claude closely on kernel code and old repos, and requires self-review before anyone else sees LLM code.

signature_quote.value: Left unchecked, LLMs will make systems larger, not better
signature_quote.more: — appealing to perverse vanity metrics, perhaps, but at the cost of everything that matters.
